editorial:
You meet Gavin, an atheist who shares an apartment with his gay best friend Chris. When Gavin starts an affair with Shana, the wife of a strict fundamentalist Christian named Joe, things spiral fast. Joe discovers the affair and turns it into a deadly game of beliefs, forcing Gavin onto a high-rise ledge with an impossible choice. The whole movie plays out like a tense standoff between two men who refuse to back down.

The acting keeps you locked in, especially the tense back-and-forth between the two leads, and the pacing rarely lets up. The downside is the heavy-handed speeches about faith and atheism, which can feel preachy at times. If you enjoy character-driven thrillers with moral dilemmas, this is for you. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Gavin tells Hollis the truth: Joe threatened to kill Chris unless Gavin jumps. Despite Hollis begging him to step back, Gavin jumps to his death to save his friend. Police arrest Joe, and Shana walks away from him. Hollis, shaken, decides to forgive his wife and stay with her. The movie ends on a quiet note about sacrifice and belief.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves character-driven thrillers with moral dilemmas.
